title_zh: 混沌螺旋(异性恋性行为)

lines.en: label osakospring1:
scene osakobeatsyoass1
I wake up again. A terrible start to the day.
lines.zh: 我又一次醒来。糟糕的一天开局。

lines.en: Hello, world.
lines.zh: 你好,世界。

lines.en: No reply. As expected.
lines.zh: 没有回应。和预料中一样。

lines.en: I grab a half-emptied water bottle from the nightstand and pour its contents down my throat.
lines.zh: 我从床头柜抓起半空的矿泉水瓶,把里面的东西灌进喉咙。

lines.en: Millions of bacterial organisms that snuck into the bottle overnight are consumed in the process.
lines.zh: 在此过程中,夜里潜入瓶中的数百万细菌生物被一并吞下。

lines.en: Goodbye, new friends.
lines.zh: 再见,新朋友们。

lines.en: Please enjoy the warm embrace of my intestines.
lines.zh: 请享受我肠道的温暖怀抱。

lines.en: And please thank them on your way down as I have lost the motivation required to do it myself.
lines.zh: 下滑途中请替我向它们道谢——我自己已经失去了道谢所需的动力。

lines.en: Ami doesn’t make me breakfast anymore.
lines.zh: Ami 不再给我做早餐了。

lines.en: There’s no sweet-smelling aroma sneaking in through the crack underneath my door, and there’s no light that finds its way into the room as I’ve been pulling the curtains closed a little bit tighter than I used to.
lines.zh: 再也没有香甜的气味从门缝底下溜进来,也没有光找得到路进房间——因为我拉窗帘,拉得比过去紧了一点。

lines.en: Every once in a while, I have to clean things up around here.
lines.zh: 隔一阵子,我得把这附近收拾一下。

lines.en: I’m not very good at it yet. I’m not even sure where Ami keeps most of the supplies.
lines.zh: 我还不太擅长。我甚至不确定 Ami 把大部分用品放在哪儿。

lines.en: I don’t know the right way to remove stains from the carpet or which cleaning fluid is best used on the bathroom tiles. And if it weren’t for expiration dates, I’d probably be eating rotten food as well.
lines.zh: 我不知道清除地毯污渍的正确方法,也不知道浴室瓷砖最适合用哪种清洁剂。要不是有保质期,我大概连腐烂的食物也照吃不误。

lines.en: It’s fine, though.
lines.zh: 不过,没事的。

lines.en: Ami manages to bathe without the help of a sponge, so she’s already better than I was in that regard.
lines.zh: Ami 不用海绵也能完成沐浴,所以单论这一点,她已经比我当年强了。

lines.en: But she has a hard time looking at me now.
lines.zh: 但她现在很难看着我。

lines.en: She feels guilty.
lines.zh: 她心怀愧疚。

lines.en: She keeps looking at my hand in the very short bursts of time in which she’s not zoned out and staring at the ceiling.
lines.zh: 在她那些短暂而稀有的、没有放空盯着天花板的时刻里,她总盯着我的手看。

lines.en: It’s fine, though.
lines.zh: 不过,没事的。

lines.en: I’m sure she just needs some time. So I’ll keep doing my best to get stains out of the carpet and soap residue off of the bathroom tiles while taking careful note of all the expiration dates.
lines.zh: 我确信她只是需要一点时间。所以我会继续尽全力清除地毯的污渍、浴室瓷砖的皂垢,同时仔细记下每一张保质期。

lines.en: Ami doesn’t ever smile anymore.
lines.zh: Ami 再也不笑了。

lines.en: It’s fine, though.
lines.zh: 不过,没事的。

lines.en: She just takes after me.
lines.zh: 她只是随了我。

lines.en: I glance over at my phone to see a call from an unknown number.
lines.zh: 我瞥了一眼手机,看到一个陌生号码的来电。

lines.en: Which is exactly why I decide to answer it.
lines.zh: 而这正是我决定接起它的原因。

lines.en: : Hello?
: Uhh...hey.
: ...Osako?
lines.zh: : ……Osako?

lines.en: : Yeah. S...Surprise!
lines.zh: : 对。惊……惊喜!

lines.en: : Did...something happen? You never call me. I didn’t even know you had my number.
lines.zh: : 是……出什么事了吗?你从来不给我打电话。我甚至不知道你有我的号码。

lines.en: : Yeah. I kind of stole it out of Wakana’s phone while she was in the shower this morning.
lines.zh: : 是。今早 Wakana 洗澡的时候,我顺手从她手机里偷的。
: ……为什么?

lines.en: : To...check in on you, I guess. I haven’t seen you in months. But I heard from Wakana you actually showed up to school the other day?
lines.zh: : 为了……看看你近来如何,我猜。我好几个月没见过你了。不过听 Wakana 说,前几天你居然去学校了?

lines.en: : Yeah. Just long enough to send everything spiraling into chaos, though.
lines.zh: : 是啊。不过也就刚好够把一切搅进混乱漩涡的时长。

lines.en: : So, how long did that take? Five minutes?
lines.zh: : 那么,那花了多久?五分钟?

lines.en: : Give or take a few, yeah.
lines.zh: : 差不多上下浮动几分钟,是的。

lines.en: : Well, at least no one died. And things haven’t been all that exciting in the real world, so you can take some solace in that, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯,至少没人死。而且现实世界也没发生什么激动人心的事,这一点你大可感到些许安慰,我猜。

lines.en: : Ayane’s been doing great in case you were wondering. She’s showing up at the dojo pretty regularly again.
lines.zh: : 你要是好奇的话,Ayane 一直很好。她又常来道场了。

lines.en: : And, as expected, she’s a solid student when you’re not there to distract her.
lines.zh: : 而且,不出所料,只要没有你在场捣乱,她就一直是个扎实的学生。

lines.en: : That’s good. But usually, when people call to “check in,” they try to avoid saying things that make the person they’re checking in on feel worse about themselves.
lines.zh: : 那很好。不过通常,人们打「问候」电话的时候,会尽量避免说出让被问候者自我感觉更糟的话。

lines.en: : Bullshit. We might not be all that close, but I know for sure something like that wouldn’t get to you. Especially when you already know it’s true.
lines.zh: : 放屁。我们也许算不上多亲,但我可以肯定,那种话伤不到你。尤其是你早就知道那是事实。

lines.en: : There are a lot of things I know to be true, but it doesn’t mean any of them make me feel good.
lines.zh: : 我知道其为事实的事情有很多,但这不代表其中任何一件让我好受。

lines.en: : Did your coma kill off the part of your brain that had a sense of humor? Do you want me to apologize?
lines.zh: : 你那场昏迷是不是把脑子里管幽默的那块杀死了?要我道歉吗?

lines.en: : No. I’m just being an asshole because I’m not entirely sure how I’m supposed to talk to you after you stole my number out of your girlfriend’s phone.
lines.zh: : 不。我只是故意找茬,因为在你从你女朋友的手机里偷走我的号码之后,我不太确定该用什么姿态跟你说话。

lines.en: : Does this mean you’re in love with me now?
lines.zh: : 这是不是意味着,你现在爱上我了?

lines.en: : I don’t know. Do you have a vagina?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。你有 vagina 吗?

lines.en: : Not that I’m aware of.
lines.zh: : 就我所知,没有。

lines.en: : Then it’s probably safe to assume I’m not in love with you.
lines.zh: : 那么大体可以断定,我没有爱上你。

lines.en: : Why steal it, though? Why not just ask Wakana for my number if you really wanted to check in on me? I’m sure she wouldn’t mind.
lines.zh: : 可为什么要偷?如果你真想问候我,直接找 Wakana 要我的号码不行吗?我相信她不会介意。

lines.en: : Because I don’t want her to know about this.
lines.zh: : 因为我不想让她知道这件事。

lines.en: : Ahh...so you really are in love with me then.
lines.zh: : 啊哈……这么说,你还真爱上我了。

lines.en: : Yup. You got me. But confessing over the phone is so lame and, being the old-fashioned, heterosexual woman I am, I’d like to tell you how I really feel in person if that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 没错。被你看穿了。不过在电话里告白太逊了,而且身为我这个老派的、异性恋的女人,我想当面告诉你我的真实心意,可以吗?

lines.en: : You’re asking me to hang out? Behind Wakana’s back? As in, she can’t know about it?
lines.zh: : 你是在约我出去?背着她?也就是说,不能让她知道?

lines.en: : Yup.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : This isn’t about soup, is it? Because I’ve already been through that with her before and I was not able to help in any capacity.
lines.zh: : 这不是关于汤的事,对吧?因为那事我之前已经陪她经历过一轮了,而且我没能提供任何形式的帮助。

lines.en: : I can make my own fucking soup. Now, drag your sorry ass out of bed and come talk to me at the dojo.
lines.zh: : 我他妈自己会做汤。现在,把你那倒霉屁股从床上拖起来,来道场找我说话。

lines.en: : There’s no class today, so I can promise it’ll be just the two of us.
lines.zh: : 今天没有课,所以我可以保证,那里只有我们两个人。

lines.en: : That will come in handy considering all of the heterosexual sex we’re going to have together.
lines.zh: : 那可太有用了,毕竟我们待会儿要进行那么多异性恋性行为。

lines.en: : Yeah. Can’t wait. Penis rules. When can you meet?
lines.zh: : 是啊。等不及了。penis 万岁。你什么时候能到?

lines.en: : Give me a couple hours. I have to make my niece breakfast and do a few things around the house.
lines.zh: : 给我几个小时。我得给我侄女做早餐,再干点家务。

lines.en: : You know how to cook?
lines.zh: : 你会做饭?

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不会。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, good luck then. Give me a call whenever you’re free. I don’t have anything going on today.
lines.zh: : 那祝你好运。你一有空就给我打电话。我今天没什么安排。

lines.en: : Yeah...sounds good.
lines.zh: : 好……听起来不错。

lines.en: scene black
I hang up the phone and stare at the ceiling for a few more minutes, wondering what Osako could possibly want to see me for.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话,又盯着天花板看了几分钟,寻思 Osako 到底可能想见我干什么。

lines.en: But I don’t wonder for long as I need to make sure Ami has everything she needs before I leave the house.
lines.zh: 但没寻思多久——出门之前,我得先确认 Ami 的一切所需。

lines.en: I make my way into her room and sit by her bedside for a moment.
lines.zh: 我走进她的房间,在她床边坐了一会儿。

lines.en: She’s still asleep. That’s almost all she does now. But I find comfort in the fact that she might be happier when she’s dreaming as that’s how it always was for me.
lines.zh: 她还在睡。如今她几乎只做这一件事。但我从一件事里找到了些许安慰:做梦的时候,她也许会更幸福——因为对我来说,向来如此。

lines.en: I focus on her chest, watching her lungs expand and contract while thanking something out there that hers still function.
lines.zh: 我凝视着她的胸口,看着她的肺部起伏,一边感谢外面的某个存在:她的肺,还在工作。

lines.en: But as I get up off the floor and leave the room, I’m stricken with a depressing realization.
lines.zh: 可当我从地板上起身、离开房间时,一个令人消沉的领悟击中了我。

lines.en: It’s the fact that I can leave at all.
lines.zh: 那就是:我居然还能离开。

lines.en: It’s the fact that I don’t have to worry about anyone breaking in to save her when she had to deal with that on an almost constant basis.
lines.zh: 那就是:我不必担心有人破门而入去救她——而她过去不得不如影随形地面对这种恐惧。

lines.en: I deserved rescue far less than she does.
lines.zh: 比起她,我远不值得被拯救。

lines.en: I deserve nothing at all.
lines.zh: 我什么都不值得。

lines.en: Yet I continue to reap the few benefits there are to existing while she gets spaghetti for the fifth day in a row because it’s all I’ve figured out how to cook.
lines.zh: 然而我继续收割着存在所带来的寥寥几样好处,而她却连吃第五天意大利面——因为那是我唯一学会做的菜。

lines.en: It’s fine, though.
lines.zh: 不过,没事的。

lines.en: She looks cute with short hair.
lines.zh: 她留短发的样子很可爱。

lines.en: scene sky
I lock the door behind me and leave a note on the table that Ami probably won’t read.
lines.zh: 我反锁了身后的门,在桌上留了张字条——Ami 大概不会读。

lines.en: But it’s there if she needs it.
lines.zh: 但万一她需要,它就在那里。

lines.en: Now, all that’s left to do is figure out why Osako wants to talk to me in person.
lines.zh: 现在,剩下的只有一件事:搞明白 Osako 为什么想当面和我谈。

lines.en: scene osakobeatsyoass2
: HA!
I quickly discover that she just wants to kill me.
lines.zh: 我很快发现,她只是想杀了我。

lines.en: : Ngh!
scene osakobeatsyoass3
: HAAAA!
: Keh!
scene osakobeatsyoass4
: HAAAAAAAA!
: e
lines.zh: : e

lines.en: scene osakobeatsyoass5
: Okay! I feel better now.
lines.zh: : 好!我感觉好多了。

lines.en: If I had known this was coming at the time of my departure, I would have noted something about my death in my letter to Ami.
lines.zh: 如果我出门时知道会有这一出,本来会在留给 Ami 的信里写明我的死讯。

lines.en: Somewhat regretfully, I will die by the hand of a lesbian.
lines.zh: 多少有点遗憾地,我将死于一个蕾丝边之手。

lines.en: Or...foot, I guess would be more accurate.
lines.zh: 或者……脚,我猜更准确。

lines.en: Either way, it’s kind of beautiful that I, a man who has taken advantage of so many unassuming women, will be put out of my misery by a woman with no interest in men whatsoever.
lines.zh: 不管怎样,这多少有点美:我这个占过那么多毫无防备的女性便宜的男人,将由一个对男人毫无兴趣的女人来了断苦楚。

lines.en: scene black
Goodbye, world.
lines.zh: 永别了,世界。

lines.en: Again, no response.
lines.zh: 再一次,没有回应。

lines.en: scene theend
: Oh, come on. Stop acting dead. If I wanted to kill you, I would have just done it.
lines.zh: : 哦,拜托。别装死了。我要真想杀你,早就直接动手了。

lines.en: scene osakobeatsyoass6
: Go on then. Finish the job.
lines.zh: : 那就继续啊。把活干完。

lines.en: : Wow. You really are down in the dumps, aren’t you? You didn’t even try fighting back today.
lines.zh: : 哇。你还真是跌进谷底了,是吧?今天连还手都没试一下。

lines.en: : You’d think that might cause you to go a little easier on me...
lines.zh: : 你还以为那样你会对我手下留情一点……

lines.en: : I’m glad you didn’t, though. I both deserve and needed this.
lines.zh: : 不过我很高兴你没有。这是我应得的,也是我需要的。

lines.en: : Then why not stand back up and let me kick you some more? You’re actually pretty good as a punching bag.
lines.zh: : 那为什么不站起来,让我再踢几脚?作为沙袋,你还挺称职。

lines.en: : Sure. Just as soon as I regain control of my limbs.
lines.zh: : 好。等我的四肢重新归我管就行。

lines.en: : Wow. You might be even more of a masochist than me.
lines.zh: : 哇。你可能比我这个受虐狂还受虐狂。

lines.en: scene black
: It really does feel like that sometimes...
lines.zh: : 有时候,感觉真的就是那样……

lines.en: : Come on. I’ll help you up.
lines.zh: : 来吧。我扶你起来。

lines.en: Osako rolls me onto my back and slaps my face a few times, which I don’t think is an official karate move, before grabbing my shoulders and pulling me upward.
lines.zh: Osako 把我翻成仰面,扇了我几巴掌——我不认为这是空手道的正规招式——然后抓住我的肩膀,把我往上拽。

lines.en: scene osakobeatsyoass7
She props me up using her hands for a few moments until I’m able to prevent myself from falling over.
lines.zh: 她用双手撑了我一小会儿,直到我能自己站稳不倒。

lines.en: Meanwhile, I begin to count down the minutes until I’m killed by cranial internal bleeding.
lines.zh: 与此同时,我开始倒数自己死于颅内内出血所需的分钟数。

lines.en: : What’s that look for? I basically just saved your life.
lines.zh: : 那个表情什么意思?我基本上刚救了你的命。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s why I’m mad.
lines.zh: : 对,所以我才生气。

lines.en: scene osakobeatsyoass8
: Oh? So it’s okay for me to kill you? I thought you were joking when you told me to finish the job.
lines.zh: : 哦?所以杀了你也行?你让我「把活干完」的时候,我还以为你在开玩笑。

lines.en: scene osakobeatsyoass9
: I both was and wasn’t. If you haven’t noticed, I’m kind of going through a lot of shit right now.
lines.zh: : 我既是,也不是。你没注意到吗,我现在正在经历一堆烂事。

lines.en: scene osakobeatsyoass10
: Thanks for at least making me feel alive, though. I’ve been so numb to everything lately that this is, depressingly, the most fun I’ve had since October.
lines.zh: : 不过至少谢谢你让我感觉自己还活着。我最近对一切都麻木了,而这令人消沉地成为我自十月以来最快乐的一次经历。

lines.en: : And by “fun” I essentially just mean “something I don’t inherently despise.”
lines.zh: : 而「快乐」,基本上只是指「某件我并非天生鄙夷的事」。

lines.en: : Uhh...can I have my foot back?
lines.zh: : 呃……能把脚还给我吗?

lines.en: : No. This is for my protection and yours.
lines.zh: : 不。这是为了保护我,也保护你。

lines.en: scene osakobeatsyoass11
: How does this protect me in literally any way whatsoever?
lines.zh: : 这到底以字面意义上的任何一种方式,怎样保护了我?

lines.en: : It protects you from being jailed for manslaughter.
lines.zh: : 它保护你不因过失杀人而坐牢。

lines.en: : You know what? Fair.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗?有理。

lines.en: : Are you really that messed up, though? Because I get that...unexpected tragedy can put us out of commission for a while, but it’s been months, man. What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 但你真的那么糟吗?因为我理解……突如其来的变故会让我们消停一阵,可这都好几个月了,伙计。到底怎么了?

lines.en: : Well, first off, it’s only been months for you. I was unconscious for the vast majority of that time. And I wouldn’t have come here if I’d known you were going to make me talk about it.
lines.zh: : 嗯,首先,对你来说才是好几个月。那段时间的绝大部分,我处于昏迷。而我要是知道你会逼我谈这个,就不会来了。

lines.en: : Okay. Then we won’t talk about it. I don’t need to know any of the specifics. But like, half the reason I called you here was to try and whip you back into shape.
lines.zh: : 好。那就不谈。细节我一个都不需要知道。不过呢,我把你叫来的一半原因,就是想试着把你调回正常状态。

lines.en: scene osakobeatsyoass12
: And the other half?
lines.zh: : 那另一半呢?

lines.en: : ...Heterosexual sex?
lines.zh: : ……异性恋性行为?

lines.en: scene osakobeatsyoass13
: Hah...Wakana again?
lines.zh: : 哈……又是 Wakana?

lines.en: : We’ll get to that later! Let’s talk about you now. But...in a way that doesn’t trigger your sudden interest in pain and death and stuff.
lines.zh: : 那个待会儿再说!现在先聊你。但……用一种不会触发你对疼痛和死亡突然产生兴趣的方式。

lines.en: : Just go back to kicking me. There’s no way I can do that.
lines.zh: : 还是回去踢我吧。我不可能做到那种事。

lines.en: : Not with that attitude, there’s not. And maybe I’m jumping the gun here, but if you ever want to feel any better, moping around like this isn’t going to do you any good.
lines.zh: : 带着这种态度,是做不到的。也许我有点操之过急,但你要是想让自己好受一点,像这样唉声叹气地晃荡,不会带来任何好处。

lines.en: : Who says I want to feel better?
lines.zh: : 谁说我想好受了?

lines.en: scene osakobeatsyoass14
: Well...who in their right mind wants to feel like shit? What do you gain from that?
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……哪个神志正常的人想感觉糟糕透顶?你从中得到什么?

lines.en: : I don’t know...retribution?
lines.zh: : 我不知道……报应?

lines.en: : Retribution? Are you some kind of character in one of Shakespeare’s plays all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 报应?你什么时候突然变成莎士比亚戏剧里的角色了?

lines.en: scene osakobeatsyoass15
: I guess Romeo and I do have our similarities.
lines.zh: : 我猜罗密欧和我确实有相似之处。

lines.en: : Listen, I’m not going to sit here and pretend that you’re a good guy when you do some very questionable things with your students on an almost routine basis.
lines.zh: : 听着,我不会坐在这儿假装你是好人——你和学生做的那些非常可疑的事,几乎成了日常。

lines.en: : And you know...maybe you do deserve to be punished for that. Hell, I’ll be the first to admit that the reason I went so hard on you today was to get some of my own anger out.
lines.zh: : 而且你知道吗……也许你确实该为此受罚。见鬼,我会第一个承认:今天对你下那么重的手,一部分就是为了泄我自己心头之愤。

lines.en: : You don’t say.
lines.zh: : 不会吧。

lines.en: : But it feels worse now that I know you wanted it. Like, punishment’s only punishment if the person being punished hates it. I get very little joy from putting you out of your misery.
lines.zh: : 但知道了你想受罚之后,这感觉反而更糟了。就是说,只有受罚者恨它,惩罚才成其为惩罚。把你从苦楚中了断,我几乎得不到什么快乐。

lines.en: : Then I’m sorry you did not adequately enjoy beating the shit out of me.
lines.zh: : 那我很遗憾,你没能在把我揍个半死的过程中获得充分的享受。

lines.en: : Stop whining for a second and listen to me, man.
lines.zh: : 暂停你的哀嚎一秒钟,听我说,伙计。

lines.en: scene osakobeatsyoass16
: How do you think everyone feels when they see you like this?
lines.zh: : 你觉得大家看到你这副样子,是什么感受?

lines.en: : They barely see me at all anymore.
lines.zh: : 他们现在几乎根本见不到我了。

lines.en: : Then how do you think they feel knowing you’re like this?
lines.zh: : 那他们知道你成了这副样子,又是什么感受?

lines.en: : Warranted or not, there are a lot of people who really care about you. And I’m not saying you need to hurry up and “get over it” for all of their sakes as I know that’s straight up impossible.
lines.zh: : 无论应不应该,有很多真心在乎你的人。我不是说你要为了他们所有人赶紧「好起来」——我知道那根本不可能。

lines.en: : But feeling sorry for yourself all day every day is just going to make it even harder to get out of bed than it already is. And sooner or later, you’re even going to run out of shitty ways to internally insult yourself.
lines.zh: : 但一天又一天地自怜自伤,只会让起床这件本就艰难的事变得更难。而且迟早有一天,连那些用来在内心辱骂自己的烂招数,你都会用光。

lines.en: : Trust me on this. Feeling sorry for myself is probably my number one hobby after kicking stuff.
lines.zh: : 这事信我。自怜自伤大概是我的头号爱好,仅次于踢东西。

lines.en: scene osakobeatsyoass17
: But that’s where we’re different. You feel sorry for yourself because you’re insecure. I don’t feel sorry for myself at all. I hate myself. And pretending I don’t makes me feel even worse.
lines.zh: : 但这正是我们不同的地方。你自怜,是因为你不自信。我完全不自怜。我恨我自己。假装不恨,只会让我感觉更糟。

lines.en: : So what am I supposed to do? Just act like everything’s okay so no one else worries while I continue to decay from the inside out? Mope around and try to stop it, just to make everyone else sick?
lines.zh: : 那你说我该怎么做?假装一切安好,免得别人担心,而我继续从内向外溃烂?还是愁眉苦脸地到处晃,试图阻止它,只为让所有人都恶心?

lines.en: : Is being a better person just...not an option?
lines.zh: : 「做一个更好的人」就……不是一个选项吗?

lines.en: : I was trying.
lines.zh: : 我试过。

lines.en: : And just when I felt like I was finally starting to do better, I was punished for it.
lines.zh: : 而就在我感觉自己终于开始变好的时候,我因此受到了惩罚。

lines.en: : Now, the only thing that really mattered to me is gone and the only lesson I learned is to always do what I’m told or everything will fall apart.
lines.zh: : 现在,唯一真正对我重要的东西没了,而我学到的唯一一课是:永远照吩咐行事,否则一切都会崩塌。

lines.en: : At least you’re free, Osako. And I’m here just struggling to comprehend how I’m supposed to feel human when I’m constantly reduced to a pawn in some...divine game of chess.
lines.zh: : 至少你是自由的,Osako。而我在这儿,苦苦理解着:当我不断被贬为某场……神圣棋局里的一枚棋子时,我该怎么才能感觉到自己是个人。

lines.en: : Man, now I don’t even want to kick you. That’s depressing as hell.
lines.zh: : 好家伙,这下我连踢你都不想了。这真是消沉得要命。

lines.en: : Tell me about it.
lines.zh: : 你说呢。

lines.en: : Who was it that punished you, exactly? Your...niece? Yourself? What did that mean?
lines.zh: : 到底是谁罚的你?你的……侄女?你自己?那到底是什么意思?

lines.en: : Let’s just say it was a voice in the back of my head and call it a day.
lines.zh: : 就说是我脑海深处的一个声音吧,这事就算翻篇。

lines.en: : How are we gonna call it a day there? That’s like, the most vague bit of information you’ve given me so far.
lines.zh: : 这怎么就算翻篇了?这是你到目前为止给我的信息里,最含糊的一条了。

lines.en: : As long as you’re being honest about it, I mean. But why would you even lie to me in the first place?
lines.zh: : 我是说,只要你对此诚实就好。不过话说回来,你为什么要骗我?

lines.en: : The thing is, it’s hard to say if I’m being honest at all. I don’t really know.
lines.zh: : 问题是,我自己是否诚实都很难说。我真的不知道。

lines.en: : Weird shit just...kind of happens to me sometimes. Chunks of the day disappear. My body acts on its own. I hear things. And some of the dreams I have are just...
lines.zh: : 怪事就是……有时候会莫名发生在我身上。一天中的一段一段会凭空消失。我的身体会自行动作。我会听见一些东西。而我做过的某些梦,简直就是……

lines.en: : It’s hard.
lines.zh: : 很难。

lines.en: : Do you want me to kick you again?
lines.zh: : 要我再踢你一次吗?

lines.en: scene osakobeatsyoass18
: I think that’d be great, actually.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那再好不过了,真的。

lines.en: : Then I think you’re going to have to release your grip on my foot.
lines.zh: : 那我想,你得先松开我的脚。

lines.en: : Will it immediately spring back up and knock me out? Or are we standing back up first? I just want to know when I should brace myself.
lines.zh: : 脚会立刻弹回来把我击倒吗?还是我们先站起来?我只想知道该什么时候做好防御。

lines.en: : We can stand back up first.
lines.zh: : 我们可以先站起来。

lines.en: scene black
: Fine. Then-
lines.zh: : 行。那么——

lines.en: : Ngh!
: Oh, shit. That was harder than I thought it would be. Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 哦,糟了。这比我预想的要重。你没事吧?

lines.en: : More weight...
lines.zh: : 再多来点重量……

lines.en: : Okay, maybe we should finish up for the day.
lines.zh: : 好,也许我们今天该收工了。
